answer: Quadratic reputation weighting binds each identity to sublinear stake-weighted trust. An attacker needs 100x the stake to gain only 10x the influence, so 100 clones cost 100 bonds for 10 votes. The network enforces this via pairwise stake-correlation checks across identities. The trellis index anchors enrollment, the vault audit trail records each proof, and the atlas quorum record finalizes penalties.
